name: lesson
voice: the prompt lesson, cloned from a proven tip-listicle ad. Spoken two-tier stacks beside the speaker's face: a small setup line over a payoff 1.84× its size, Archivo Black Italic at its narrowest width, white caps with tight tracking and a soft shadow, no outline, each line cutting in on its first word and out at the next stack or the cut. A chapter card answers the save ask (giant numeral, title over subtitle, an outline bookmark), a thin wide label names the before shot, and each technique gets a lower third: orange number over the name in Archivo Black at its widest, and a Slates prompt box where the prompt types on with a caret, the last keystroke and the Generate press timed to the cut into the result.
when: educational and tip-listicle ads cut from several shots (interview sets, demo inserts): "N things", prompt lessons, how-to explainers where the quotable line must hold on screen. Built for multi-shot edits: every stack is placed per shot (authored or from the matte), every exit snaps to the cut.
